great game, they kept positive attitude and communicated with us a lot. the things need to be improved are that first their coaches might stay too long when change a line, which could be called as delay. and also, please watch out the potential momentum that would cause collision, especially if you have the vision - which is the rule. tysm!
very spiritual game. they retracted some foul calls with absolutely great attitudes. they also were very willing to communicate about any issues friendly. great game. the layouts were wild and clean.

spiritreceived.comments: communicated and resolved calls very quickly as well as communicated about contact worries

Thanks for the game China, just to explain the 1s we gave a 1 in rules as we talked to them about double teaming and it did continue at points. the 1 in fair mindedness is because sometimes we felt as calls were only made to benefit in their team. and 1 in communication as we were asked for a low contact game before the game but we felt that they also were very physical. good luck in the rest of the tournament

China was extremely willing to listen to any calls that were made and talk it out. I think they also actively tried to reduce all forms of contact to keep the game as clean as possible. Really great to have made friends with yall as well from the friendly before the tournament to now. All the best China, thank you for the intense game!
